findings.description: Ciriaco Bardales and Carmen Morales had a son, also named Ciriaco Bardales, born in 1905 and died 12 August 1905 at Guatemala City, registered 13 August 1905.
supporting_sources: Guatemala, Guatemala, Registro Civil, 1874-2008 — death registration of 13 Aug 1905 naming parents Ciriaco Bardales and Carmen Morales

findings.description: Carmen Morales was the mother of the 1905 infant — a partner of Ciriaco Bardales before his marriage to Clara Amelia Palacios Oliva.

person.name: Carmen Morales
person.role: named as the child's mother on the 1905 death registration

supporting_sources: Guatemala, Guatemala, Registro Civil, 1874-2008 — death registration of 13 Aug 1905
